methods.name: bit_chunks
methods.summary: Returns a [`BitChunks`] instance which can be used to iterate over this buffer's bits in `u64` chunks

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Claim memory used by this buffer in the provided memory pool.

methods.signature: fn collect_bool<F: FnMut(usize) -> bool>(len: usize, f: F) -> Self
methods.summary: Invokes `f` with indexes `0..len` collecting the boolean results into a new `BooleanBuffer`

methods.name: count_set_bits
methods.summary: Returns the number of set bits in this buffer

methods.summary: Finds the position of the n-th set bit (1-based) starting from `start` index. If fewer than `n` set bits are found, returns the length of the buffer.

methods.summary: Create a new [`BooleanBuffer`] by applying the bitwise operation `op` to the relevant bits from two input buffers.

methods.summary: Returns true if this [`BooleanBuffer`] is empty

methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the bits in this [`BooleanBuffer`]

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the length of this [`BooleanBuffer`] in bits (not bytes)

methods.signature: fn new(buffer: Buffer, bit_offset: usize, bit_len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`BooleanBuffer`] from a [`Buffer`], `bit_offset` offset and `bit_len` length

methods.name: new_set
methods.summary: Create a new [`BooleanBuffer`] of `length` bits (not bytes) where all values are `true`

methods.name: new_unset
methods.summary: Create a new [`BooleanBuffer`] of `length` bits (not bytes) where all values are `false`

methods.name: offset
methods.summary: Returns the offset of this [`BooleanBuffer`] in bits (not bytes)

methods.name: ptr_eq
methods.summary: Returns true if this [`BooleanBuffer`] is equal to `other`, using pointer comparisons to determine buffer equality. This is cheaper than `PartialEq::eq` but may return false when the arrays are logically equal

methods.name: set_indices

methods.summary: Returns a `u32` iterator over set bit positions without any usize->u32 conversion

methods.name: set_slices
methods.summary: Returns a [`BitSliceIterator`] yielding contiguous ranges of set bits

methods.name: shrink_to_fit
methods.summary: Free up unused memory.

methods.summary: Slices this [`BooleanBuffer`] by the provided `offset` and `length`
